source='''def transform(grid):
    # Separator rows and columns are the full-color lines between panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 5]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 5]
    row_edges = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_edges)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_edges[ri]+1, row_edges[ri+1]
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_edges)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_edges[ci]+1, col_edges[ci+1]
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == 7 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else 5)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
